summary: Added sdk/execution (runner.py, __init__.py): ActionRunner takes an injected client, snapshot provider, journal and clock. It refuses and journals a snapshot from another alias before any call, journals precondition failures as skipped, journals dry runs without making a mutating call, calls the Client method exactly once with no retry, and refuses (UncertainPriorAttemptError) to repeat a non-idempotent action whose last attempt with the same params is unknown unless allow_after_uncertain is set. Exceptions, non-boolean responses and failed after-snapshots are journaled as unknown unless the effect was observed; outcomes carry signed resource deltas. Added 14 fake-client tests covering every path, and docs/baseline/action-runner.md. Not wired into run.py, per the slice notes.

contract_status_changes.contract: R1 exit: scheduled, attributed, observed and reconciled operations
contract_status_changes.before: No component links an action call to observed state change or to a durable record
contract_status_changes.after: One catalog action can be executed for a named account with before/after snapshots, reconciliation, explicit uncertainty and a journal record, offline-tested with a fake client

residual_risks: No live snapshot provider exists yet, so the runner has not been exercised against the game; the R1 exit evidence is offline only.
Client.upgradeRooms is untargeted; upgrade_room reconciliation covers only the requested room.
The uncertain-prior check reads the whole journal on each non-idempotent run; this is fine for small journals but should be indexed before long-running schedules.
open_questions: R2 needs a live snapshot provider built from Client reads and a daily scheduler; should those be queued as the next slices, and may they run against an owned test account?
